title: Effect on an appended coordinate pair
statement: Let $r,k$ be nonnegative integers, let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^{r+2k}$, and let $a,b\in\mathbb{F}_2$. The paired-coordinate linear automorphism on $\mathbb{F}_2^{r+2(k+1)}$, applied to the vector formed by appending $a,b$ to $x$, gives the vector formed by appending $a+\sum_i x_i$ and $b+\sum_i x_i$ to the image of $x$ under the paired-coordinate automorphism on $\mathbb{F}_2^{r+2k}$, where the sum is in $\mathbb{F}_2$.
